title: Doctor row: the installed bee binary must not lag the source checkout
action: Add one mechanical row binary-freshness to bee doctor (see mechanical_rows and the Row{key, ok, detail} shape). It exists ONLY in a bee SOURCE checkout — detect the same way devtools gates its source-only verbs (SOURCE_CHECKOUT_DEV_VERBS neighbourhood: presence of packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml under the repo root); in a host project the row is absent entirely, never a not_ok. In a source checkout it reports not_ok when either (a) the installed .bee/bin/bee reports a different --version than the source Cargo.toml package version, or (b) any source input is NEWER by mtime than the installed binary — inputs are packages/bee-rs/crates/**/*.rs, packages/bee-rs/**/Cargo.toml, and packages/bee/prompts/*.md. Detail names the reason concretely: the two versions when they differ, else the newest offending path and both mtimes. Remedy sentence in the detail: cargo build --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee, then copy it to .bee/bin/bee. Missing binary stays the existing host-binary rows job — this row reports unknown when no binary is installed. Tests (find the doctor test module; the second file in files is a guess, use the real one and reserve it): fresh binary is ok, an mtime-newer source file makes it not_ok naming the path, a version mismatch makes it not_ok naming both versions, a non-source checkout omits the row.

truths: Row absent in a host project, never a false alarm
not_ok detail names the offending path or the two versions, plus the rebuild remedy
No binary installed reads unknown, not not_ok
Read-only: the row never builds, copies, or writes anything

trace.outcome: Added binary_freshness doctor row (source-checkout only): version-parity + mtime-freshness checks, unknown-without-binary, absent-on-host; 5 new tests

deviations: Second files entry in the cell (doctor_tests.rs) was a guess; the real test module is packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/doctor/tests.rs (doctor.rs already declares mod tests under doctor/) - reserved and edited that path instead, per the cell action note.
Version comparison uses bee rs-info's version field (CARGO_PKG_VERSION) since bee has no --version flag; the source side is packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml's [workspace.package] version.
